tender.description: Prabhag kr. 26 mahmadwadi kusarbag tarawde vasti s.no. 93 mahmadwadi yethil dada gujar shale shejaril kai. Dattoba urfa aappa shankarrav Pazar talav yethe sant srusti ubahrne. (navin pr. Kr. 41)
